features.description: Turning axis = CAD world X. CAD a=0 at the spigot end face, a=210 at the threaded end face. Transform used for all NC values: S1 Z = a - 210; S2 Z = -a; X = 2 x radius (diameter).
Front (threaded-end) face, annulus D30..D50. Area check: pi/4*(50^2-30^2) = 1256.637 mm2 minus 235.052 mm2 (external thread groove, same value as F22) = 1021.585 mm2, which matches CAD exactly.
features.location: CAD a=210 -> S1 Z0 (finished front face)

features.description: Rear (spigot-end) face. The area 594.705 mm2 does not close with a D12 bore (D29.9 annulus + key section = 614.03 mm2) or with a D14 bore (573.2 mm2). The difference to D12 (19.3 mm2) is consistent with an internal thread groove cut outside D12, but this is not resolved.
features.location: CAD a=0 -> S2 Z0 (finished rear face)

features.description: OD D50, carries the external thread F20
Concave R5 between D50 and shoulder F06. Tangent points are (a=85, D50) and (a=80, D60); centre is (a=85, D60), derived from the blend span and the F06 inner diameter.
features.location: S1: G02 from X50 Z-125 to X60 Z-130, centre X60 Z-125

features.description: Flange face towards the thread end, annulus D60..D100. Inner D60 is inferred from the area: pi/4*(100^2-60^2) = 5026.548 mm2 = CAD area.
Flange OD D100, 20 mm thick
features.location: CAD a=60..80 -> S1 Z-130..-150 (turned in S1 to Z-152 as overlap); S2 Z-60..-80

features.description: Flange face towards the spigot end, annulus D70..D100. Area check: pi/4*(100^2-70^2) = 4005.53 mm2 = CAD area.
Concave R5 between D60 and shoulder F08. Tangent points are (a=55, D60) and (a=60, D70); centre is (a=55, D70).

features.description: OD D60

Face at the spigot root, annulus D29.9..D60 less 6 holes and the key section. Area check: 2125.29 - 58.39 - 24.97 = 2041.94 mm2 vs CAD 2041.918. The lathe faces it from D36.7 to D60 only; the rest is made by the mill.
Spigot D29.9 carrying the raised key F13. A turned D29.9 would destroy the key, so the lathe leaves a D36.7 envelope and the D29.9 is produced off-lathe around the key.
Raised key on the spigot: flat top 17.9 mm from the axis, side flats 7.98 apart. Corner radius sqrt(17.9^2+3.99^2) = 18.339 mm gives a minimum turned envelope of D36.68.
features.location: CAD a=0..20 -> S2 Z0..-20, angular position unknown

features.description: 6 x D3.52 blind holes parallel to the axis on PCD46, 60 deg spacing, entering face F11. Off-axis, not turnable.
Bore D30 open at the front face
Bottom of the D30 bore, annulus D13..D30. Area check: pi/4*(30^2-13^2) = 574.13 mm2 = CAD area.
Bore D13. It ends 168.58 mm from the front face and 41.42 mm from the rear face.
Bore D12 open at the rear face (internal thread region). The CAD Hole feature says D14 x 41.42, while the evaluated geometry says D12.
Two small planar faces at the D12/D13 step (7.472 + 7.782 mm2 against a full step annulus of 19.635 mm2). The remainder is presumably consumed by the thread groove.
Modelled external thread, pitch 5, right-hand, on D50. Designation, depth and class are UNKNOWN; the majorDiameter parameter 25 is not usable.
Modelled internal thread, pitch 2, right-hand, near D12/D13. Designation, depth and class are UNKNOWN; the majorDiameter parameter 25 is not usable.

Planar face at a=85 with area 235.052 mm2. This equals exactly the thread-groove area missing from F02, so it is interpreted as the end cap of the modelled thread at the fillet tangent, not as a turned shoulder. This is my interpretation.

unclear_or_missing.item: External thread designation, standard, class, thread depth and major-diameter tolerance
unclear_or_missing.why: UNKNOWN in CAD; threadCreator text and majorDiameter=25 are not usable. OP80 uses an ASSUMED ISO 60 deg basic depth of 0.6134 x P = 3.067 mm on major D50 (assumption A10).
The modelled thread runs to a=85, the fillet tangent (F22), with no undercut or runout. A single-point thread cannot end there. OP80 ends at Z-120 (a=90) as an assumption.

unclear_or_missing.item: Internal thread p=2: designation and producibility
unclear_or_missing.why: Designation is UNKNOWN. T09 cannot cut it: its 12 mm bar does not fit a D12 bore, and its reach of 15 mm is less than the 41.42 mm length.

unclear_or_missing.item: D12 vs D14 bore and face-area mismatches
unclear_or_missing.why: The Hole feature says D14, the geometry says D12, and the F03/F19 areas do not close with either value.

unclear_or_missing.item: Tool for the D12 bore from solid
unclear_or_missing.why: The tool table has no D12 or smaller drill, except the T10 spot drill with reach 10. T05 D13 would oversize the bore. The boring bars need a pilot hole.

unclear_or_missing.item: D13 bore depth vs drill reach
unclear_or_missing.why: From the front the bore ends 168.58 mm deep, but T05 reach is 70 mm. From the rear, a D13 drill would destroy the D12 section. Only a=~145..170 is producible.
UNKNOWN (not returned by the API). It is also unknown whether the drilled D13 is acceptable as a finished bore.
None modelled, so none are programmed and all edges are sharp.
The team has not specified it (accepted). The programs assume nothing protrudes in front of S2 Z-82, i.e. a protected grip on D50.
The real part carries 29 mm of excess length beyond a=0 (240 - 210 - 1). The LatheLab stock dialog for S2 loads a raw bar with only 1 mm face allowance.

unclear_or_missing.item: Meaning of tool 'reach' for OD turning tools
unclear_or_missing.why: The S1 shoulder at a=80 is 25 mm radial (D50 to D100) and the S2 shoulder at a=60 is 15 mm, against T01/T02 reach of 15. These may be flagged by LatheLab.
